title: Permission to keep
summary: Let the collector's instinct live, without turning every saved thing into an obligation.
epitaph: It doesn't have to become something.
revive_when: Saving something starts to feel like promising to finish it.

related.reason: A short eulogy keeps the useful part of unfinished work without creating a new commitment.

origin: The owner's founding brief for graveyard; summarized by the caretaker.
